title: Add NNTP per-command latency histograms to reader daemon
description:
Instrument every NNTP command handler in the reader with a histogram observation for its total handling time: nntp_command_duration_seconds{command='ARTICLE'}, {command='OVER'}, {command='POST'}, etc. Use tokio-tracing span timing or explicit Instant::now() measurements. Artifact: instrumentation added to reader/src/session/commands/*.rs.

Acceptance:
- Every command handler emits a histogram observation on completion
- Command label matches the RFC 3977 command name (uppercase)
- POST histogram covers end-to-end time including IPFS write
- Unit test: issue 5 commands, verify 5 histogram observations recorded
